-health-check.name: -health-check
-health-check.description: Internal health check. Verifies ActiveCampaign API URL, token, and connectivity.

list-contacts.name: list-contacts
list-contacts.description: List contacts. Returns { items[{id,email,firstName,lastName,phone}], total, nextOffset }. Filter by email, free-text search, or listId.

params.listId: Only contacts subscribed to this list

get-contact.name: get-contact
get-contact.description: Get a contact by id. Returns { contact: {id,email,firstName,lastName,phone,cdate,udate} }.

create-contact.name: create-contact
create-contact.description: Create a contact. Email is required. Returns { contact } with the created record. ActiveCampaign upserts by email; if it exists you get the existing contact.

update-contact.name: update-contact
update-contact.description: Update a contact by id. Only provided fields are updated. Returns { contact }.

delete-contact.name: delete-contact
delete-contact.description: Delete a contact by id. Permanent — no soft-delete in ActiveCampaign. Returns { id, deleted: true }.

list-lists.name: list-lists
list-lists.description: List subscriber lists. Returns { items[{id,name,stringid,subscriberCount}], total, nextOffset }.

subscribe-contact-to-list.name: subscribe-contact-to-list
subscribe-contact-to-list.description: Subscribe (or unsubscribe) a contact to a list. Returns { contactList: {id, contact, list, status} }.

list-campaigns.name: list-campaigns
list-campaigns.description: List email campaigns. Returns { items[{id,name,type,status,subject,sendDate,totalRecipients,totalOpens,uniqueOpens}], total, nextOffset }.

get-campaign.name: get-campaign
get-campaign.description: Get a campaign by id. Returns { campaign: {id,name,subject,status,sendDate,fromName,fromEmail,totalRecipients,opens,clicks} }.

list-deals.name: list-deals
list-deals.description: List deals (CRM pipeline records). Returns { items[{id,title,value,currency,status,contact,pipeline,stage}], total, nextOffset }.

get-deal.name: get-deal
get-deal.description: Get a deal by id. Returns { deal: {id,title,description,value,currency,status,contact,pipeline,stage,owner} }.

create-deal.name: create-deal
create-deal.description: Create a deal. Required: title, value (in major units), pipelineId, stageId, ownerId. value is converted to cents internally. Returns { deal }.

params.value: Deal value in major units (e.g. 1500 for $1,500)

list-tags.name: list-tags
list-tags.description: List tags. Returns { items[{id,name,description,tagType}], total, nextOffset }.

add-tag-to-contact.name: add-tag-to-contact
add-tag-to-contact.description: Assign a tag to a contact. Returns { contactTag: {id, contact, tag} }.

name: ActiveCampaign
description: ActiveCampaign CRM and email marketing — manage contacts, lists, campaigns, deals, and tags via the v3 API.
